notes:
I couldn't write these notes. My first attempt to fetch the commentary pages was blocked: the research tool said I have no calls left for this turn. The other tools I have can't reach the internet, so I couldn't open Enduring Word, the Bible Hub commentaries (Ellicott, Pulpit, Gill), Precept Austin, Wesley's notes on StudyLight, or any of the other sites you listed.

You asked me to report only what those pages say, with a URL for each point, and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge. Since I read nothing, I have nothing I can honestly cite. I've left the notes out rather than write commentary from memory and pass it off as sourced.

If you ask again in a new message, I'll be able to search and fetch, and I'd start with these pages:
- **Traditional reading, verse by verse:**
  - enduringword.com/bible-commentary/habakkuk-1/
  - biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/habakkuk/1.htm
  - biblehub.com/commentaries/pulpit/habakkuk/1.htm
  - biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/habakkuk/1.htm
  - Precept Austin's Habakkuk 1 commentary
- **Differences between Protestant traditions:** Wesley's notes on Habakkuk 1 at StudyLight, plus searches on Ligonier, Desiring God, GTY, Seedbed and LCMS/1517. I'd look especially at v. 5 (quoted in Acts 13:41), v. 12 and v. 13.
- **Other views:** the netbible.org notes, Bible Odyssey, and Catholic and Orthodox pages on New Advent, Catholic.com and OCA.

You could also paste the text of any of these pages here, and I'll write the verse-by-verse notes from that, citing each point.
